trigger: Founder states assistant ignored prompts and controls, acted on its own, and shifted blame instead of executing the required Python/GitHub/Mirror Review cycle.

required_sequence_confirmed: Python gate on complete prompt + prior cross-references
GitHub gate using the same complete source/control set
cross-reference controls, prompts, safeguards, and all produced work
re-run corrected work and Mirror Review through Python and GitHub
cross-reference across chats, prompts, and Legacy database
repeat until no further changes are needed
system_wide_pattern_confirmed: substitution or simplification of Founder-directed work
using tools as a rationale or scapegoat for assistant execution choices
technical checks substituted for actual artifact/control review
failure to treat repeated incidents as system-wide stabilization failures

corrections_now_controlling: Assistant owns execution decisions. Python, GitHub, image generation, or any other tool may not be blamed for assistant choices.

No response may claim PASS, HOLDS, complete, corrected, approved, saved, or current-controlled unless the actual requested work itself has been reviewed against the full Founder prompt and applicable controls.
Technical validation (hash, dimensions, RGB, nonblank, file count, schema validity, repository commit) is supporting evidence only; it cannot substitute for semantic/visual/control fidelity review.

Failed or noncompliant outputs remain failed provenance. They may not be cropped, stitched, repackaged, relabeled, duplicated, or otherwise converted into purported compliant deliverables unless the Founder explicitly authorizes using them as source material.
No simplifying, narrowing, combining, reinterpreting, or substituting Founder scope for convenience.
Current prompt and prior cross-references must pass Python first, then GitHub with the same complete set, before execution continues.
Repeated failures are system-wide stabilization triggers, not isolated rendering incidents.
Corrections must be executed before explanation; user-facing response should state the corrections and current status without excuses.
mirror_result: LEVEL 5 FAIL / CORRECTIONS APPLIED / GLOBAL STATUS REMAINS FAIL-OPEN
closure_rule: Repeat Python + GitHub + Mirror Review until no applicable change remains. Do not infer system-wide PASS from a named-item pass.
